name: @zizalend/sdk
description: Typed API client for the Zizalend lending protocol

scripts.//pretest: This package's request and response types are aliases into @zizalend/types, so the types package has to be generated and built before anything resolves them. CI does this explicitly; doing it here as well is what makes `npm test` work in a fresh clone.
scripts.//test: jest is installed at the workspace root rather than in this package, so the test scripts reach up one level. `node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js` resolved to nothing from here, which made `npm test` in this package fail with a bare module-not-found.
